content.comment_body: I'm having trouble uploading a project from my [product_name]. I connected it to my laptop using an Ethernet cable and assigned IP addresses: my laptop has IP 172.27.224.199 with subnet 255.255.255.0 and gateway 172.27.224.1; the [product_name] has IP 172.27.224.200 with the same subnet and gateway. The connection itself works, but when I attempt to upload, I first receive a message warning that uploading will overwrite the existing diagrams on the PC. After confirming, I then see another prompt stating the configured device will be replaced because its device type differs from the connected device. When I confirm again, there is no further progress. The same thing happens when I try to download a project to the [product_name]; no action occurs.

Which [product_name] model are you using? Please provide the complete [article_no] and firmware version. What configuration did you select for the [product_name] in your hardware settings? Are you connecting directly or through a router? If it's via a router, is DHCP enabled?
Never mind, I realized I was using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. After updating to [version_no], everything is working now. Thank you for your response.
That's exactly why I asked for those details...

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced issues with uploading and downloading projects between a [product_name] and a PC, despite a successful network connection. The root cause was outdated [product_name] programming software. After updating to a newer version, the issue was resolved, highlighting the importance of software compatibility. No detailed error messages were shown, except for alerts regarding device type mismatch, causing confusion about the underlying problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected smooth uploading and downloading of project data between a [product_name] and their PC once the devices were correctly networked.
